cells.gaps: No adopting act is named (approval stated by El Chaab and the High Commissioner only). Reporting is activity throughout, measured against no strategy target, so stage 4 is not reached; the plan has actions with no cost (executive plan 2027-2030 in preparation); no domestic budget line is tied to the strategy (UNDP/Japan donor support only). Earlier DZA-050 'drafting' (Aug 2024) and 'announced'/'validated' rows are superseded by the later adoption rows.
cells.note: Instrument: Stratégie nationale de transformation numérique 2025-2030. Adopted, text public on the High Commission site and period to 2030, so stage 3; no published results against its own targets, so not 4.
